name: Hexedrone
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: A rare mephedrone analogue also known as MACP, it is a cathinone stimulant with similar effects to pentedrone.

pharmacology.text: Through analysis of the Structure-Activity Relationships in similar cathinones such as MDPV, hexedrone is believed to be a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Hexadrone is a stimulant of the substituted cathinone class which has been sold as a designer drug. Due to its novelty and extremely short history of human usage, all information related to the use of this compound should be treated with caution.
